title: A reward you can check
summary: Pick the post-training signal when unit tests can score a program.

choices.text: DPO, because the pass/fail bit on a single response is already a complete preference pair, so the test results feed DPO as they are.
Reinforcement learning with a verifiable reward: the test outcome is the reward, not a learned model of human taste.
Supervised fine-tuning on the prompts alone, with the tests used only to set the learning rate.
The KL penalty against the reference model, which is itself a reward for whether the program passed.
